text:
Adam Edstrom is 6'7", has 82 hits in 19 games, and has become a regular in Nashville after the Rangers used him sparingly. He is playing 14:51 a night, up from 9:28 last season, with 6 goals and 7 points.

This one looks real. He has 6.26 expected goals on his own shots, and his 1.33 expected goals per 60 is up from 0.76. His 6 goals match his chances almost exactly, so there is no luck to give back. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking, on a small sample, had him getting shots off passes across the slot or from behind the net, and his tip against Carolina on Nov 3 is the type. At five on five Nashville has 53.9% of the expected goals with him on, 8.7 points better than without him.

It is 19 games. Ice time settles faster than scoring does, and his line leans on dump-ins and the forecheck. But a sixth-round pick finding this role at 26 is a good story either way.
headline: Adam Edstrom's breakout is built on real chances
